plivo contacto — handles authentication to the Contacto stack for agent
management commands. Session is stored at ~/.plivo/contacto.toml and consumed by
'plivo agent list/get/create/update/attach'.

A Contacto session is distinct from the Plivo API credentials (auth_id +
auth_token) used by 'plivo number/message/call/application/auth whoami'.

Usage:
  plivo contacto [command]

Available Commands:
  login       Log in to Contacto (POSTs /v1/accounts/login-cli on global hodor)
  logout      Clear the saved Contacto session
  whoami      Print the currently logged-in Contacto session

Global Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo contacto [command] --help" for more information about a command.
